name: fix-ci-manifest-push
body: source: global.constraint.humans-push-and-tag 'Pushing … must be done by humans only'; inconsistency: package-manifest-update needs CI to commit formula/manifest updates in-tree (same-repo tap/bucket), which the constraint forbade (feedback-34); resolution [with user]: constraint narrowed — the CI release workflow may push manifest-only commits (version/URL/checksum updates under `Formula/` and `bucket/`); humans still push all code and create all tags; agents never push or tag. Reflected in the constraint, the package-manifest-update AC (commit touches only Formula/ and bucket/, no CI tags) and the release-workflow component.
